overall.assessment: Podcast pokazuje snažnu usmjerenost na 'misijsku opciju' Crkve, koristeći suvremene digitalne alate za prenošenje evanđeoske poruke mladima. Pristup don Tomislava Lukača balansira između jasnog nauka o dostojanstvu života i braka te potrebe za autentičnim susretom s osobom u njezinoj konkretnoj situaciji. Iako format kratkih videa nosi rizik od redukcionizma, cjelokupni ton odiše željom za evangelizacijom koja je ukorijenjena u sakramentalnom životu i duhovnom razlučivanju.

sections.subtitle: Druga sezona podcasta: Iva i Don Tomislav Lukač otvaraju vrata digitalne misije
sections.screenshot_description: Iva, voditeljica podcasta, pozdravlja slušatelje na početku druge sezone, s osmijehom na licu, dok najavljuje gosta Don Tomislava Lukača.
sections.content:
Voditeljica Iva s ponosom i zahvalnošću otvara drugu sezonu svog podcasta, prisjećajući se kako je prošle godine projekt započeo s mnogo neizvjesnosti, ali jasnom vizijom. Izražava duboku zahvalnost Bogu na prilici da se bavi ovim poslom, na svakom gostu iz prethodne sezone te na podršci publike – svakom lajku, komentaru, dijeljenju i pretplati. Ističe važnost pretplate na YouTube kanal, naglašavajući da je to 'jedan klik koji jako, jako puno znači za rast ovog kanala i nastavak snimanja'. Iva također spominje novu opciju financijske podrške putem platforme Patreon, gdje simbolični iznosi, poput cijene jedne kave mjesečno, omogućuju nastavak rada i dovođenje sugovornika koji obogaćuju živote slušatelja. Posebnu zahvalnost upućuje generalnom pokrovitelju Angelumu, koji je prepoznao vrijednost razgovora i podržava podcast od samih početaka.  

S velikim uzbuđenjem, Iva najavljuje svog prvog gosta u novoj sezoni – mladog i popularnog salezijanca, **Don Tomislava Lukača**, koji je doputovao iz Rima. Don Tomislav je poznat po svojoj aktivnosti na društvenim mrežama, gdje ga na TikToku i Instagramu prati gotovo 200 tisuća ljudi. Iva ističe njegovu sposobnost da dopre do ljudi, opisujući ga kao osobu 'koju nema tko ne voli'. Najavljuje da će razgovor obuhvatiti Don Tomislavov poziv, reakcije njegove obitelji i tadašnje djevojke, aktualnosti vezane uz mlade, te 'škakljivije teme' poput evangelizacije na društvenim mrežama i kontroverznih crkvenih nauka. Unatoč duljini epizode, Iva uvjerava slušatelje da će vrijeme proletjeti i da će razgovor biti vrijedan pažnje.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj odražava kršćansku zahvalnost i ispravno razumijevanje evangelizacije kao Božjeg djela, a ne ljudskog projekta.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva potiče korištenje suvremenih sredstava komunikacije za širenje Radosne vijesti, naglašavajući da su to prostori u kojima se susreću ljudi. Zahvalnost i poniznost u radu ključni su za autentično svjedočenje vjere.
magisterium.assessment_en: The content reflects Christian gratitude and a correct understanding of evangelization as God's work, and not a human project.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church encourages the use of modern means of communication for spreading the Good News, emphasizing that these are spaces in which people meet. Gratitude and humility in work are key for authentic witnessing of faith.

sections.subtitle_en: Second season of the podcast: Iva and Don Tomislav Lukač open the doors of the digital mission
sections.screenshot_description_en: Iva, the podcast host, greets the listeners at the beginning of the second season, with a smile on her face, while announcing the guest Don Tomislav Lukač.
sections.content_en:
Host Iva with pride and gratitude opens the second season of her podcast, remembering how last year the project started with much uncertainty, but a clear vision. She expresses deep gratitude to God for the opportunity to do this work, for every guest from the previous season, and for the support of the audience – every like, comment, share, and subscription. She emphasizes the importance of subscribing to the YouTube channel, stressing that it is 'one click that means very, very much for the growth of this channel and the continuation of filming'. Iva also mentions a new option of financial support through the Patreon platform, where symbolic amounts, like the price of one coffee per month, enable the continuation of work and bringing interlocutors who enrich the lives of listeners. She sends special gratitude to the general sponsor Angelum, who recognized the value of the conversations and supports the podcast from the very beginnings.

With great excitement, Iva announces her first guest in the new season – the young and popular Salesian, **Don Tomislav Lukač**, who traveled from Rim. Don Tomislav is known for his activity on social networks, where almost 200 thousand people follow him on TikTok and Instagram. Iva emphasizes his ability to reach people, describing him as a person 'whom there is no one who does not love'. She announces that the conversation will cover Don Tomislav's calling, the reactions of his family and his girlfriend at the time, current events related to youth, and 'trickier topics' like evangelization on social networks and controversial Church teachings. Despite the length of the episode, Iva assures listeners that time will fly by and that the conversation will be worthy of attention.

sections.subtitle: Molitva za digitalne misionare: Blagoslov za širenje Božje riječi
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav Lukač sklopljenih ruku, s ozbiljnim izrazom lica, vodi uvodnu molitvu za uspjeh podcasta i digitalne evangelizacije.
sections.content: Prije nego što započne razgovor, Don Tomislav Lukač predvodi uvodnu molitvu, zahvaljujući Bogu na susretu i prilici da budu Njegovo sredstvo u svijetu, putem društvenih mreža i podcasta. Ističe vjeru da je ovo Božje djelo i da je njihova prisutnost tu s razlogom. Moli za vodstvo Duha Svetoga u svemu što će govoriti, kako bi donosili Boga, a ne sebe. Posebno se moli da podcast bude koristan svima koji će ga slušati, a pogotovo onima koji su se udaljili od Boga, kako bi se mogli ponovno približiti. Molitva završava zazivom 'Kristu, Gospodinu našemu', a Iva mu zahvaljuje na blagoslovu i molitvi.

magisterium.assessment: Molitva i zaziv Duha Svetoga prije početka rada u potpunosti su u skladu s katoličkom praksom i teologijom poslanja.
magisterium.enrichment: Kršćansko poslanje nije ljudski pothvat, već suradnja s Božjom milošću. Zaziv Duha Svetoga osigurava da evangelizator ostane sredstvo, a ne cilj, čime se izbjegava narcizam u digitalnom prostoru.
magisterium.assessment_en: Prayer and invocation of the Holy Spirit before starting work are completely in accordance with Catholic practice and the theology of mission.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Christian mission is not a human endeavor, but cooperation with God's grace. The invocation of the Holy Spirit ensures that the evangelizer remains a means, and not an end, thereby avoiding narcissism in the digital space.

sections.subtitle_en: Prayer for digital missionaries: Blessing for the spreading of God's word
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav Lukač, with folded hands, with a serious expression on his face, leads the introductory prayer for the success of the podcast and digital evangelization.
sections.content_en: Before the conversation begins, Don Tomislav Lukač leads the opening prayer, thanking God for the meeting and the opportunity to be His instrument in the world, through social networks and podcasts. He emphasizes the belief that this is God's work and that their presence is there for a reason. He prays for the guidance of the Holy Spirit in everything they will speak, so that they would bring God, and not themselves. He especially prays that the podcast would be useful to everyone who will listen to it, and especially to those who have distanced themselves from God, so that they could draw close again. The prayer ends with the invocation 'To Christ, our Lord', and Iva thanks him for the blessing and the prayer.

sections.subtitle: Papa Franjo okuplja 'digitalne misionare': Konferencija u Rimu i izazovi online evangelizacije
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav Lukač gestikulira dok objašnjava važnost konferencije katoličkih influencera u Rimu, naglašavajući Papinu podršku.
sections.content:
Don Tomislav Lukač dijeli svoja iskustva s nedavne konferencije u Rimu, posvećene takozvanim 'digitalnim misionarima'. Objašnjava da je to bio povijesni događaj, prvi put da je Sveta godina uključivala susret za one koji su aktivni na društvenim mrežama. Iako se često koriste terminom 'katolički influenceri', Don Tomislav ističe da je preferirani izraz 'digitalni misionari', jer im glavni cilj nije biti influencer, već širiti Božju riječ.  

Konferenciju je sazvao sam **Papa Franjo**, poglavar Katoličke crkve, kako bi ohrabrio svećenike, časne sestre i laike angažirane u digitalnom prostoru. Papa je naglasio važnost evangelizacije u današnjem svijetu, koji je u velikoj mjeri prisutan na društvenim mrežama, te im zahvalio što žive riječi 'Idite i navješćujte evanđelje po svem svijetu'. Don Tomislav ističe da je Papina podrška ključna, jer se često susreće s komentarima poput 'zašto je svećenik na društvenim mrežama?'. Papa je također upozorio na napast da se u tom angažmanu donosi sebe, a ne Boga.  

Na konferenciji je sudjelovalo oko 900 ljudi iz cijelog svijeta, od čega 250 do 300 aktivnih digitalnih misionara. Don Tomislav, kao jedini predstavnik iz Hrvatske, iskoristio je priliku za upoznavanje i razmjenu iskustava s kolegama iz različitih zemalja, što je opisao kao obogaćujuće i ohrabrujuće iskustvo. Smatra da društvene mreže predstavljaju veliko bogatstvo za Crkvu, omogućujući dosezanje velikog broja ljudi, uključujući i one koji su udaljeni od vjere, te ih potencijalno približavaju Crkvi i Bogu.  

Posebno je istaknuo susret s **Lila Rose**, poznatom pro-life aktivisticom iz Amerike, kojoj se divi zbog hrabrosti. Don Tomislav je pratio njezine podcaste, posebno one usmjerene na osobe s homoseksualnim sklonostima, gdje je intervjuirala psihoterapeute koji pomažu ljudima da se oslobode tih sklonosti. Smatra da su Amerikanci mnogo napredniji u razumijevanju tih delikatnih tema, a susret s Lila Rose ga je dodatno ohrabrio da nastavi s radom.

magisterium.assessment: Pravilno se razlikuje terminologija 'digitalnog misionara' od 'influencera', stavljajući naglasak na naviještanje Krista, a ne na osobnu promociju.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva potiče evangelizaciju u digitalnom svijetu, ali upozorava na izazove poput senzacionalizma i potrebu za razlučivanjem. Digitalni misionari pozvani su svjedočiti istinu o životu i dostojanstvu osobe, uključujući osjetljive teme, s poštovanjem i jasnoćom.
magisterium.assessment_en: The terminology of 'digital missionary' is properly distinguished from 'influencer', putting emphasis on the proclamation of Christ, and not on personal promotion.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church encourages evangelization in the digital world, but warns of challenges such as sensationalism and the need for discernment. Digital missionaries are called to witness to the truth about life and the dignity of the person, including sensitive topics, with respect and clarity.

sections.subtitle_en: Pope Francis gathers 'digital missionaries': Conference in Rome and challenges of online evangelization
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav Lukač gesticulates while explaining the importance of the conference of Catholic influencers in Rome, emphasizing the Pope's support.
sections.content_en:
Don Tomislav Lukač shares his experiences from a recent conference in Rome, dedicated to the so-called 'digital missionaries'. He explains that it was a historical event, the first time that the Holy Year included a meeting for those who are active on social networks. Although they often use the term 'Catholic influencers', Don Tomislav points out that the preferred term is 'digital missionaries', because their main goal is not to be an influencer, but to spread God's word.

The conference was called by **Pope Francis** himself, the head of the Catholic Church, in order to encourage priests, nuns, and laypeople engaged in the digital space. The Pope emphasized the importance of evangelization in today's world, which is to a large extent present on social networks, and thanked them for living the words 'Go and proclaim the gospel to all the world'. Don Tomislav points out that the Pope's support is crucial, because he often encounters comments like 'why is a priest on social networks?'. The Pope also warned of the temptation to bring oneself, and not God, in that engagement.

About 900 people from all over the world participated in the conference, of which 250 to 300 were active digital missionaries. Don Tomislav, as the only representative from Croatia, used the opportunity to get to know and exchange experiences with colleagues from different countries, which he described as an enriching and encouraging experience. He considers that social networks represent a great wealth for the Church, enabling the reaching of a large number of people, including those who are far from the faith, and potentially bringing them closer to the Church and God.

He especially highlighted the meeting with **Lila Rose**, a well-known pro-life activist from America, whom he admires for her courage. Don Tomislav followed her podcasts, especially those aimed at people with homosexual tendencies, where she interviewed psychotherapists who help people free themselves from those tendencies. He believes that Americans are much more advanced in understanding these delicate topics, and the meeting with Lila Rose additionally encouraged him to continue with his work.

sections.subtitle: Nevoljki početak digitalne misije: Kako je introvertirani Don Tomislav postao TikTok zvijezda
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav Lukač se smiješi dok priča o svojim počecima na društvenim mrežama, prisjećajući se kako je bio skeptičan prema TikToku.
sections.content:
Iva pita Don Tomislava bi li prije nekoliko godina povjerovao da će postati digitalni misionar. On kategorički odgovara da ne bi, ističući da je introvert i da ne voli kamere, te da bi njegovi subraća salezijanci bili iznenađeni. Smatra da je njegov angažman na društvenim mrežama dokaz da je to Božje, a ne njegovo djelo.  

Don Tomislav objašnjava kako je sve počelo s njegovim krizmanicima 2023. godine. Dok je bio đakon i mladi svećenik u Arunu, držao je mise za djecu i krizmanike, prilagođavajući propovijedi njihovom uzrastu. Grupa krizmanika počela ga je nagovarati da snima kratke videozapise o vjeri na TikToku i Instagramu, inspirirani svećenicima iz Amerike. Don Tomislav je u početku bio skeptičan, smatrajući TikTok platformom za 'gluposti, plesove i vulgarnosti', ali su ga krizmanici uvjerili da se platforma promijenila i da nudi i korisne sadržaje.  

Njegov provincijal, Don Tiho, također je prepoznao vrijednost njegovih propovijedi i potaknuo ga da ih objavljuje. Don Tomislav je, na nagovor krizmanica Ivane i Megi, snimio seriju videa za Veliki tjedan (Veliki četvrtak, Veliki petak, Uskrs), objašnjavajući značenje tih dana. Ti su videozapisi neočekivano postali viralni, dosegnuvši stotine tisuća pregleda. Djeca su ga počela prepoznavati na ulici i poticati ga da nastavi.  

Unatoč početnom uspjehu, Don Tomislav je u dva navrata želio odustati, ne želeći postati 'influencer'. Međutim, svaki put bi mu se pojavio isti biblijski citat: 'Dobar pastir neće napustiti svoje stado'. To je protumačio kao Božji poziv da nastavi, shvaćajući da je to način da dopre do onih koji su daleko od Crkve. Kasnije je, na molbu 'starijih' župljana, počeo objavljivati i na Instagramu.  

Ističe da mu nije uvijek lako. Iako je naučio nositi se s medijskom pažnjom, na početku je izbjegavao medije, želeći se fokusirati na svoj rad. Predvidio je da će ga mediji 'razapeti' kada se dotakne delikatnih tema, što se i dogodilo. Naglašava da mu je rad na društvenim mrežama samo 10% njegovih obaveza, koje uključuju kateheze, ispovijedi i rad s mladima. Održavanje prisutnosti na mrežama zahtijeva redovito objavljivanje, što je dodatni izazov za njegovu introvertiranu prirodu, ali ga prihvaća 'radi dobrog vida' i dosezanja djece i mladih.

magisterium.assessment: Osobno svjedočanstvo o introvertiranosti i neočekivanom uspjehu naglašava Božju inicijativu u evangelizaciji, što je u skladu s biblijskim modelom poziva.
magisterium.enrichment: Bog često koristi slabe i nespremne instrumente kako bi pokazao da je snaga u Njegovoj milosti, a ne u ljudskim sposobnostima. Ovo svjedočanstvo potiče povjerenje u Božje vodstvo unatoč ljudskim ograničenjima.
magisterium.assessment_en: Personal testimony about introversion and unexpected success emphasizes God's initiative in evangelization, which is in accordance with the biblical model of calling.
magisterium.enrichment_en: God often uses weak and unprepared instruments to show that strength is in His grace, and not in human abilities. This testimony encourages trust in God's guidance despite human limitations.

sections.subtitle_en: Reluctant beginning of a digital mission: How the introverted Don Tomislav became a TikTok star
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav Lukač smiles while talking about his beginnings on social networks, recalling how he was skeptical towards TikTok.
sections.content_en:
Iva asks Don Tomislav if he would have believed a few years ago that he would become a digital missionary. He categorically answers that he would not, emphasizing that he is an introvert and that he does not like cameras, and that his Salesian confreres would be surprised. He considers that his engagement on social networks is proof that this is God's work, and not his.

Don Tomislav explains how it all started with his confirmands in 2023. While he was a deacon and a young priest in Arun, he held Masses for children and confirmands, adapting the homilies to their age. A group of confirmands began to persuade him to record short videos about faith on TikTok and Instagram, inspired by priests from America. Don Tomislav was initially skeptical, considering TikTok a platform for 'nonsense, dances, and vulgarities', but the confirmands convinced him that the platform had changed and that it also offers useful content.

His provincial, Don Tiho, also recognized the value of his homilies and encouraged him to publish them. Don Tomislav, at the persuasion of female confirmands Ivana and Megi, recorded a series of videos for Holy Week (Holy Thursday, Good Friday, Easter), explaining the meaning of those days. These videos unexpectedly went viral, reaching hundreds of thousands of views. Children began to recognize him on the street and encourage him to continue.

Despite the initial success, Don Tomislav wanted to give up on two occasions, not wanting to become an 'influencer'. However, each time the same biblical quote would appear to him: 'A good shepherd will not abandon his flock'. He interpreted this as God's call to continue, realizing that this is a way to reach those who are far from the Church. Later, at the request of 'older' parishioners, he also began to publish on Instagram.

He emphasizes that it is not always easy for him. Although he learned to cope with media attention, in the beginning he avoided the media, wanting to focus on his work. He predicted that the media would 'crucify' him when he touched upon delicate topics, which indeed happened. He emphasizes that work on social networks is only 10% of his obligations, which include catecheses, confessions, and work with the youth. Maintaining a presence on the networks requires regular publishing, which is an additional challenge for his introverted nature, but he accepts it 'for the sake of good vision' and reaching children and youth.

sections.subtitle: Slučaj Severina: Istina o pobačaju i medijska manipulacija
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav Lukač objašnjava situaciju sa Severinom, naglašavajući kako je njegov stav o pobačaju bio pogrešno interpretiran u medijima.
sections.content:
Iva pita Don Tomislava o 'slučaju Severina' i kako se nosio s medijskom bukom. Don Tomislav ističe da, unatoč negativnim komentarima i medijskoj hajci, ne bi ništa promijenio u svom postupanju. I danas ga, kaže, mediji i komentatori reduciraju na 'svećenika koji se svađao sa Severinom', iako on s njom nije imao nikakvu svađu.  

Objašnjava da je sve počelo kada je Severina na svom Instagram 'storiju' objavila isječak iz njegovog videa, u kojem je on citirao drugu osobu koja je kritizirala njezinu prošlost. Severina je to iskoristila kako bi pokrenula debatu o pobačaju, izrezala kontekst i plasirala u medije kao da ju je on osobno izvrijeđao. Mnogi su povjerovali u tu laž, a mediji su objavljivali naslove poput 'Don Tomo izvrijeđao Severinu'.  

Don Tomislav je osjetio potrebu reagirati jer su ga njegovi mladi pratitelji, kojima je uzor, pitali zašto je vrijeđao Severinu. Snimio je kratak video od minute u kojem je objasnio cijelu situaciju i njezinu manipulaciju. Nakon toga se zaustavio, dok je Severina nastavila s uvredljivim komentarima, no njezini su je pratitelji počeli pozivati da se ispriča svećeniku.  

Don Tomislav joj, unatoč svemu, želi dobro i kaže da mu poziv na kavu i dalje stoji. Nada se da su ljudi iz ovog slučaja izvukli pouku: dok je Severina, koja podržava pobačaj, koristila laži, on je govorio istinu o pobačaju i njegovim štetnim posljedicama. Ističe da je Bog Bog istine i da je važno govoriti o tome kako pobačaj ne utječe samo na dijete, već i na ženu, što je potkrijepio svjedočanstvom jedne Meksikanke koja se pokajala zbog pobačaja.

magisterium.assessment: Snažno zagovaranje prava na život od začeća u potpunosti je u skladu s crkvenim naukom i moralnom obvezom svjedočenja istine u javnom prostoru.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva uči da je život svet od trenutka začeća (CCC 2271) i poziva vjernike da budu hrabri svjedoci istine, čak i kada se suočavaju s medijskim pritiscima.
magisterium.assessment_en: Strong advocacy for the right to life from conception is fully in accordance with Church teaching and the moral obligation of witnessing to the truth in the public space.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church teaches that life is sacred from the moment of conception (CCC 2271) and calls the faithful to be courageous witnesses of the truth, even when they face media pressures.

sections.subtitle_en: The Severina Case: The truth about abortion and media manipulation
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav Lukač explains the situation with Severina, emphasizing how his stance on abortion was wrongly interpreted in the media.
sections.content_en:
Iva asks Don Tomislav about the 'Severina case' and how he dealt with the media noise. Don Tomislav points out that, despite negative comments and the media witch-hunt, he would not change anything in his actions. Even today, he says, the media and commentators reduce him to 'the priest who argued with Severina', although he did not have any argument with her.

He explains that it all started when Severina published a clip from his video on her Instagram 'story', in which he quoted another person who criticized her past. Severina used this to start a debate about abortion, cut out the context, and placed it in the media as if he had personally insulted her. Many believed that lie, and the media published headlines like 'Don Tomo insulted Severina'.

Don Tomislav felt the need to react because his young followers, to whom he is a role model, asked him why he insulted Severina. He recorded a short video of one minute in which he explained the whole situation and her manipulation. After that he stopped, while Severina continued with insulting comments, but her followers began to call on her to apologize to the priest.

Don Tomislav, despite everything, wishes her well and says that his invitation for coffee still stands. He hopes that people have drawn a lesson from this case: while Severina, who supports abortion, used lies, he spoke the truth about abortion and its harmful consequences. He points out that God is the God of truth and that it is important to speak about how abortion does not only affect the child, but also the woman, which he supported with the testimony of a Mexican woman who repented of her abortion.

sections.subtitle: Trauma pobačaja: Život prije slobode i odgovornost muškaraca
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav Lukač s ozbiljnim izrazom lica govori o traumi pobačaja i važnosti pro-life stava, naglašavajući patnju žena.
sections.content:
Iva postavlja pitanje o ispovijedima žena koje su imale pobačaj. Don Tomislav Lukač potvrđuje da je čuo takve ispovijedi, kako u Arunu tako i u Međugorju. Iako preferira da žene govore o ovoj temi, jer se svećenike često diskreditira argumentom 'nemaš maternicu', osjeća se pozvanim govoriti istinu, posebno kada je tema aktualna, poput 'Hoda za život' i peticija.  

Ističe da je pobačaj duboka trauma za žene, koje se često bore s opraštanjem sebi i iznova ispovijedaju isti grijeh. Naglašava da pobačaj ostavlja teške posljedice ne samo na dijete, već i na samu ženu, koja kasnije shvati što je učinila i da je to bilo njezino dijete.  

Don Tomislav se protivi argumentu 'moje tijelo, moj izbor', objašnjavajući da dijete ima vlastiti DNA i da nije samo dio majčinog tijela. Koristi slikovitu usporedbu: 'Nikad u životu nisam vidio ženu koja ima dvije glave, četiri ruke, četiri noge i dva DNA.' Naglašava da pravo na život prethodi pravu na slobodu, jer 'ako nisi živ, ne možeš imati slobodu'.  

Također, ističe odgovornost muškaraca, očeva te djece, koji bi se trebali više zalagati za zaštitu života i biti podrška ženama. Zaključuje da se filozofski argumenti za pobačaj često 'ruše u vodu', ali da se mladima često prezentira samo jedna strana priče, bez prave istine. Stoga, on nastoji biti 'glasnik istine'.

magisterium.assessment: Naglašavanje odgovornosti muškaraca za začeti život u potpunosti je u skladu s crkvenim dokumentima o obitelji i dostojanstvu osobe.
magisterium.enrichment: Papa Ivan Pavao II. u 'Gratissimam Sane' (12) ističe da su i otac i majka odgovorni za novi život te da muškarac ne može izbjeći tu odgovornost, jer je ona dio njegove očinske uloge.
magisterium.assessment_en: Emphasizing the responsibility of men for conceived life is fully in accordance with Church documents on the family and the dignity of the person.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Pope John Paul II in 'Gratissimam Sane' (12) emphasizes that both the father and the mother are responsible for new life and that a man cannot avoid that responsibility, because it is part of his paternal role.

sections.subtitle_en: Trauma of abortion: Life before freedom and the responsibility of men
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav Lukač with a serious expression on his face speaks about the trauma of abortion and the importance of the pro-life stance, emphasizing the suffering of women.
sections.content_en:
Iva asks a question about the confessions of women who have had an abortion. Don Tomislav Lukač confirms that he has heard such confessions, both in Arun and in Međugorje. Although he prefers that women speak about this topic, because priests are often discredited with the argument 'you don't have a uterus', he feels called to speak the truth, especially when the topic is current, like 'Hod za život' and petitions.

He points out that abortion is a deep trauma for women, who often struggle with forgiving themselves and confess the same sin over and over again. He emphasizes that abortion leaves severe consequences not only on the child, but also on the woman herself, who later realizes what she has done and that it was her child.

Don Tomislav opposes the argument 'my body, my choice', explaining that the child has its own DNA and is not just a part of the mother's body. He uses a vivid comparison: 'I have never in my life seen a woman who has two heads, four arms, four legs, and two DNAs.' He emphasizes that the right to life precedes the right to freedom, because 'if you are not alive, you cannot have freedom'.

Also, he points out the responsibility of men, the fathers of those children, who should advocate more for the protection of life and be a support to women. He concludes that philosophical arguments for abortion often 'fall into the water', but that young people are often presented with only one side of the story, without the real truth. Therefore, he strives to be a 'messenger of truth'.

sections.subtitle: Homoseksualnost i crkveni nauk: Izazovi interpretacije i reintegrativna terapija
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav Lukač objašnjava kompleksnost crkvenog nauka o homoseksualnosti, naglašavajući razliku između osuđivanja grijeha i grešnika.
sections.content:
Iva otvara temu homoseksualnosti, podsjećajući na Papine izjave o pobačaju i pogrešne interpretacije njegovih riječi o blagoslivljanju homoseksualnih parova. Don Tomislav Lukač, iz poštovanja prema Papi, izbjegava kritiku, ali priznaje da bi volio da je Papa bio jasniji u svojim izjavama. Smatra da su Papine riječi mogle biti pogrešno shvaćene kao blagoslov čina ili para, a ne pojedinca. Kasnije je Papa Franjo pojasnio da blagoslivlja pojedinca, a ne grijeh. Don Tomislav ističe da se i sam često susreće s izvlačenjem iz konteksta i pogrešnim interpretacijama.  

Iako izbjegava snimanje videa o homoseksualnosti, osjetio je potrebu progovoriti kada se ta tema počela nametati kao 'poželjna' i 'normalna', izjednačavajući se s tradicionalnim brakom. Naglašava da ne osuđuje osobe, već grijeh, i da je važno razlikovati te dvije stvari. Bio je optužen za promicanje 'konverzijske terapije' kada je spomenuo mogućnost oslobađanja od homoseksualnih sklonosti. Don Tomislav pojašnjava da se radi o **reintegrativnoj terapiji**, koja istražuje uzroke tih sklonosti, često povezane s traumama iz djetinjstva ili nedostatkom očeve figure.  

Odbacuje ideju da je 'Bog tako stvorio' homoseksualne osobe, argumentirajući da takav Bog ne bi bio ljubav, već bi mučio ljude. Smatra da je to Sotonino djelo, koji izokreće Božje stvaranje. Don Tomislav ističe da se susreće s mnogim mladim muškarcima koji se žele osloboditi tih sklonosti i zahvalni su mu na njegovom stavu. Preporučuje podcaste Lila Rose, gdje psihoterapeuti, uključujući bivše homoseksualce, govore o reintegrativnoj terapiji i često ukazuju na nedostatak muške figure u djetinjstvu kao ključni faktor.  

Spominje i zanimljiv podatak iz knjige 'The Male Couple', koju su napisali LGBT aktivisti s ciljem razbijanja predrasuda, a koja je pokazala da nijedan od 156 intervjuiranih homoseksualnih parova nije zadržao istog partnera dulje od pet godina, što, prema Don Tomislavu, ukazuje na to da takvi odnosi nisu stvoreni da traju i ne mogu ispuniti čovjeka.

magisterium.assessment: Izražavanje želje za jasnoćom oko blagoslova je legitimno, no spominjanje 'reintegrativne terapije' zahtijeva oprez jer nije službeno crkveno stajalište.
concerns: Spominjanje specifične terapije koja nije službeno podržana od strane Crkve kao univerzalni pastoralni pristup.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva poziva na pastoralnu skrb koja je u potpunosti u skladu s njezinim naukom (CDF, 1986), naglašavajući da blagoslovi ne smiju odobravati grešne čine, već trebaju biti izraz pastoralne blizine.
magisterium.assessment_en: Expressing a desire for clarity regarding blessings is legitimate, but mentioning 'reintegrative therapy' requires caution because it is not an official Church position.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church calls for pastoral care which is completely in accordance with her teaching (CDF, 1986), emphasizing that blessings must not approve sinful acts, but should be an expression of pastoral closeness.
concerns_en: Mentioning a specific therapy that is not officially supported by the Church as a universal pastoral approach.

sections.subtitle_en: Homosexuality and Church teaching: Challenges of interpretation and reintegrative therapy
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav Lukač explains the complexity of Church teaching on homosexuality, emphasizing the difference between condemning the sin and the sinner.
sections.content_en:
Iva opens the topic of homosexuality, recalling the Pope's statements about abortion and the wrong interpretations of his words about blessing homosexual couples. Don Tomislav Lukač, out of respect for the Pope, avoids criticism, but admits that he would have liked the Pope to have been clearer in his statements. He considers that the Pope's words could have been misunderstood as a blessing of the act or the couple, and not of the individual. Later, Pope Francis clarified that he blesses the individual, and not the sin. Don Tomislav points out that he himself often encounters taking out of context and wrong interpretations.

Although he avoids filming videos about homosexuality, he felt the need to speak out when this topic began to impose itself as 'desirable' and 'normal', equating itself with traditional marriage. He emphasizes that he does not condemn persons, but the sin, and that it is important to distinguish these two things. He was accused of promoting 'conversion therapy' when he mentioned the possibility of liberation from homosexual inclinations. Don Tomislav clarifies that it is about **reintegrative therapy**, which explores the causes of these inclinations, often connected with childhood traumas or the lack of a father figure.

He rejects the idea that 'God created [them] that way' homosexual persons, arguing that such a God would not be love, but would torture people. He considers that this is Satan's work, who distorts God's creation. Don Tomislav points out that he encounters many young men who want to free themselves from these inclinations and are grateful to him for his stance. He recommends the podcasts of Lila Rose, where psychotherapists, including former homosexuals, speak about reintegrative therapy and often point to the lack of a male figure in childhood as a key factor.

He also mentions an interesting piece of information from the book 'The Male Couple', which was written by LGBT activists with the aim of breaking prejudices, and which showed that none of the 156 interviewed homosexual couples kept the same partner longer than five years, which, according to Don Tomislav, points to the fact that such relationships are not created to last and cannot fulfill a person.

sections.subtitle: Uloga oca i potraga za istinom: Razumijevanje homoseksualnih sklonosti
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav Lukač s naglašenim izrazom lica govori o važnosti očeve figure u razvoju identiteta i utjecaju na homoseksualne sklonosti.
sections.content:
Don Tomislav Lukač ponovno naglašava da se u 90% slučajeva mladih muškaraca s homoseksualnim sklonostima, s kojima se susreće, problem krije u djetinjstvu, najčešće u figuri oca. Bilo da je otac bio odsutan, grub ili je postojao neki drugi oblik traume, nedostatak snažne muške figure sprječava dječake da se identificiraju s muževnošću. To ih, objašnjava, navodi da kasnije traže idealnu sliku sebe u drugome, umjesto da razvijaju vlastitu muškost.  

Preporučuje slušanje tri podcasta Lila Rose, u kojima psihoterapeuti, uključujući dvojicu bivših homoseksualaca koji su se oslobodili tih sklonosti, detaljno objašnjavaju ovaj fenomen. Oni potvrđuju da je nedostatak muške figure često korijen problema. Don Tomislav ističe da ne osuđuje te osobe, već im pristupa s milosrđem, unatoč tome što ga neki percipiraju kao 'kamenovatelja'.  

Kao 'fun fact' spominje knjigu 'The Male Couple', koju su napisala dva LGBT aktivista s ciljem razbijanja predrasuda. U istraživanju 156 homoseksualnih parova, otkrili su da nijedan par nije zadržao samo jednog partnera tijekom pet godina. Don Tomislav to tumači kao dokaz da takvi odnosi ne mogu ispuniti čovjeka, jer 'nešto što te ne može ispuniti, ne ispuni te, i onda tražiš dalje'.  

Zaključuje da je ključno biti objektivan i iskren u potrazi za istinom, a ne samo tražiti potvrdu vlastitih uvjerenja. Izražava želju da se više svećenika u Hrvatskoj educira o ovoj temi, jer su američki izvori mnogo napredniji u razumijevanju reintegrativne terapije, koja pomaže ljudima da prepoznaju i riješe uzroke svojih sklonosti, umjesto da ih se 'preobraćuje' u nešto što nisu. Naglašava da Bog ne stvara ljude s takvim sklonostima, već da je to rezultat izokretanja Božjeg plana.

magisterium.assessment: Naglašavanje važnosti očeve figure je ispravno, no pripisivanje uzroka homoseksualnih sklonosti isključivo tom faktoru je psihološka interpretacija, a ne crkveni nauk.
concerns: Pretjerano pojednostavljivanje psihološke geneze homoseksualnih sklonosti.
magisterium.enrichment: Katekizam (2357) navodi da psihološka geneza homoseksualnosti ostaje uglavnom neobjašnjena, stoga pastoralni pristup treba biti oprezan, cjelovit i usmjeren na duhovnu pratnju.
magisterium.assessment_en: Emphasizing the importance of the father figure is correct, but attributing the cause of homosexual tendencies exclusively to that factor is a psychological interpretation, and not Church teaching.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catechism (2357) states that the psychological genesis of homosexuality remains largely unexplained, therefore the pastoral approach should be cautious, comprehensive, and directed towards spiritual accompaniment.
concerns_en: Excessive simplification of the psychological genesis of homosexual tendencies.

sections.subtitle_en: The role of the father and the search for truth: Understanding homosexual tendencies
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav Lukač with an emphasized facial expression speaks about the importance of the father figure in the development of identity and the influence on homosexual tendencies.
sections.content_en:
Don Tomislav Lukač emphasizes again that in 90% of cases of young men with homosexual inclinations, whom he encounters, the problem is hidden in childhood, most often in the father figure. Whether the father was absent, harsh, or there was some other form of trauma, the lack of a strong male figure prevents boys from identifying with masculinity. This, he explains, leads them to later seek the ideal image of themselves in another, instead of developing their own masculinity. 

He recommends listening to three podcasts of Lila Rose, in which psychotherapists, including two former homosexuals who freed themselves from those inclinations, explain this phenomenon in detail. They confirm that the lack of a male figure is often the root of the problem. Don Tomislav emphasizes that he does not condemn those persons, but approaches them with mercy, despite the fact that some perceive him as 'one who stones'. 

As a 'fun fact' he mentions the book 'The Male Couple', which was written by two LGBT activists with the aim of breaking prejudices. In a study of 156 homosexual couples, they discovered that not a single couple retained only one partner during five years. Don Tomislav interprets this as proof that such relationships cannot fulfill a person, because 'something that cannot fulfill you, does not fulfill you, and then you look further'. 

He concludes that it is crucial to be objective and honest in the search for truth, and not just seek confirmation of one's own beliefs. He expresses a desire for more priests in Hrvatska to be educated on this topic, because American sources are much more advanced in understanding reintegrative therapy, which helps people to recognize and resolve the causes of their inclinations, instead of 'converting' them into something they are not. He emphasizes that God does not create people with such inclinations, but that it is the result of the distortion of God's plan.

iterations.theme_en: Digital mission, controversial topics and personal path

sections.subtitle: Svećenici na društvenim mrežama: Prednosti, rizici i nadzor
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav objašnjava kako je započeo s objavama na društvenim mrežama, okružen mladima.
sections.content:
Don Tomislav Lukač, popularni salezijanac, dijeli svoje iskustvo o prisutnosti svećenika na društvenim mrežama. Iako se opisuje kao introvert, njegov put u digitalni svijet započeo je na poticaj krizmanika koji su ga nagovarali da snima kratke videozapise o vjeri. Njegovi prvi videi o Velikom tjednu postali su viralni, što je potvrdilo njegovu misiju dosezanja ljudi izvan tradicionalnih crkvenih okvira. Don Tomislav ističe da je njegov angažman na društvenim mrežama samo mali dio njegovog svećeničkog posla, ali ga smatra Božjim djelom koje mu pomaže doprijeti do onih koji su daleko od Crkve.

Međutim, ova platforma nosi i brojne izazove. Don Tomislav se suočava s negativnim komentarima, izvlačenjem iz konteksta (poput incidenta sa Severinom) i značajnim vremenskim ulaganjem. Naglašava važnost da svećenici koji su aktivni na društvenim mrežama budu pod nadzorom svojih poglavara, poput provincijala ili biskupa. To pruža zaštitu, blagoslov i osigurava da se ne nanese više štete nego koristi. Upozorava na opasnosti kao što su oholost, spuštanje kriterija radi lajkova ili širenje teološki netočnih informacija. Iva, voditeljica podcasta, primjećuje da Don Tomislavova 'vanjština' možda dodatno privlači pažnju, na što on odgovara da je to, kao i svi njegovi talenti, dar od Boga, s ciljem privlačenja mladih vjeri.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj ispravno prepoznaje važnost digitalne prisutnosti svećenika kao sredstva evangelizacije, uz naglasak na nužnu razboritost.
magisterium.enrichment: Drugi vatikanski sabor potiče laike i kler na suradnju u apostolatu, a digitalni prostor postaje suvremeno 'polje' gdje se vjera može svjedočiti (Apostolicam Actuositatem 13).
magisterium.assessment_en: The content correctly recognizes the importance of the digital presence of priests as a means of evangelization, with an emphasis on necessary prudence.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Second Vatican Council encourages the laity and clergy to cooperation in the apostolate, and the digital space becomes a contemporary 'field' where faith can be witnessed (Apostolicam Actuositatem 13).

sections.subtitle_en: Priests on social media: Advantages, risks and supervision
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav explains how he started with posts on social networks, surrounded by young people.
sections.content_en:
Don Tomislav Lukač, a popular Salesian, shares his experience about the presence of priests on social networks. Although he describes himself as an introvert, his path into the digital world began at the encouragement of confirmation candidates who urged him to record short videos about the faith. His first videos about Holy Week became viral, which confirmed his mission of reaching people outside traditional church frameworks. Don Tomislav emphasizes that his engagement on social networks is only a small part of his priestly work, but he considers it God's work that helps him reach those who are far from the Church.

However, this platform also brings numerous challenges. Don Tomislav faces negative comments, taking out of context (like the incident with Severina), and a significant investment of time. He emphasizes the importance that priests who are active on social networks be under the supervision of their superiors, like the provincial or the bishop. This provides protection, blessing, and ensures that more harm than good is not caused. He warns of dangers such as pride, lowering criteria for the sake of likes, or spreading theologically incorrect information. Iva, the host of the podcast, notices that Don Tomislav's 'appearance' might additionally attract attention, to which he replies that this, like all his talents, is a gift from God, with the goal of attracting young people to the faith.

sections.subtitle: Don Tomislavova priča o pozivu: Analogija slagalice
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav objašnjava svoj poziv koristeći analogiju slagalice.
sections.content: Don Tomislav Lukač objašnjava svoj svećenički poziv koristeći slikovitu analogiju slagalice. Kaže da, poput beznačajnog šarenila dijelova slagalice na hrpi, njegov poziv nije bio odmah jasan. Tek postupnim slaganjem pojedinih 'pazli', odnosno događaja i susreta s određenim osobama, počela se nazirati jasna slika. Ističe da poziv nije isključivo osobna odluka, niti je to izravna Božja objava, već kombinacija Božje inicijative i slobodnog ljudskog odgovora. Svaka 'pazla' predstavlja ključni trenutak ili osobu koja ga je usmjerila prema spoznaji da se najviše može ostvariti kao svećenik.

magisterium.assessment: Analogija slagalice ispravno opisuje proces razlučivanja kao suradnju Božje milosti i ljudske slobode.
magisterium.enrichment: Razlučivanje poziva nije izum, već otkrivanje Božjeg providnosnog plana kroz molitvu, sakramente i duhovno vodstvo (Lund-Molfese, 'Christian Duty of Discerning').
magisterium.assessment_en: The analogy of the puzzle correctly describes the process of discernment as the cooperation of God's grace and human freedom.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Discernment of vocation is not an invention, but the discovery of God's providential plan through prayer, sacraments, and spiritual direction (Lund-Molfese, 'Christian Duty of Discerning').

sections.subtitle_en: Don Tomislav's story about vocation: The puzzle analogy
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav explains his vocation using the analogy of a puzzle.
sections.content_en: Don Tomislav Lukač explains his priestly vocation using a vivid analogy of a puzzle. He says that, like an insignificant colorfulness of puzzle pieces in a pile, his vocation was not immediately clear. Only by the gradual assembling of individual 'puzzle pieces', that is, events and encounters with certain people, did a clear picture begin to emerge. He emphasizes that a vocation is not exclusively a personal decision, nor is it a direct revelation of God, but a combination of God's initiative and a free human response. Each 'puzzle piece' represents a key moment or person that directed him towards the realization that he can fulfill himself the most as a priest.

sections.subtitle: Majčino otkrivenje i potvrda poziva
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav govori o majčinom otkrivenju koje je potvrdilo njegov poziv.
sections.content: Jedna od najznačajnijih 'pazli' u Don Tomislavovom pozivu bilo je majčino otkrivenje. Kada je roditeljima priopćio svoju odluku, njegova majka, sva uplakana, otkrila mu je da su prije njega imali dva spontana pobačaja. Liječnici su ih upozorili na visok rizik treće trudnoće, pa čak i na mogućnost malformacija djeteta. Unatoč tome, njegova majka je molila Boga, obećavši da će prihvatiti dijete kakvo god ono bilo. Don Tomislav je rođen zdrav. Iako u trenutku svoje odluke nije znao za ovu priču, majčino svjedočanstvo poslužilo je kao snažna potvrda njegovog poziva, pokazujući kako je Bog djelovao u njegovom životu od samog začeća. Njegova majka mu je uvijek ostavljala slobodu izbora, ali ovaj događaj bio je duboko znakovit.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak ispravno tumači majčinu žrtvu i posvetu djeteta Bogu kao znak Božje providnosti, uz poštivanje svetosti života.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva naučava da roditelji trebaju s radošću i zahvalnošću prihvatiti Božji poziv djetetu na posvećeni život ili svećeništvo (KKC 2233).
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage correctly interprets the mother's sacrifice and the consecration of the child to God as a sign of God's providence, with respect for the sanctity of life.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church teaches that parents should accept with joy and gratitude God's call to a child to consecrated life or the priesthood (CCC 2233).

sections.subtitle_en: Mother's revelation and confirmation of the vocation
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav speaks about his mother's revelation which confirmed his vocation.
sections.content_en: One of the most significant 'puzzle pieces' in Don Tomislav's vocation was his mother's revelation. When he communicated his decision to his parents, his mother, all in tears, revealed to him that before him they had had two miscarriages. Doctors had warned them of the high risk of a third pregnancy, and even of the possibility of malformations of the child. Despite this, his mother prayed to God, promising that she would accept the child whatever it might be. Don Tomislav was born healthy. Although at the moment of his decision he did not know about this story, his mother's testimony served as a strong confirmation of his vocation, showing how God had acted in his life from conception itself. His mother always left him freedom of choice, but this event was deeply significant.

sections.subtitle: Prošle veze i poziv na celibat
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav priča o svojim prošlim vezama i kako je shvatio poziv na celibat.
sections.content: Don Tomislav otvoreno govori o svojim prošlim vezama, spominjući dvije ozbiljnije. Iako je u jednoj bio duboko zaljubljen i mogao je zamisliti budućnost s tom djevojkom, uvijek mu je nešto nedostajalo. Od malih nogu osjećao je snažnu želju za prenošenjem vjere djeci i mladima, ali nije vidio konkretan put za to unutar tadašnjeg dijacezanskog svećeništva. Ključni trenutak dogodio se u trećem razredu srednje škole kada ga je prijateljica upoznala sa salezijanskim svećenikom. Taj svećenik, koji je aktivno radio s mladima, postao je utjelovljenje njegove želje. Don Tomislav je shvatio da su salezijanci svećenici posvećeni radu s djecom i mladima, što je bila karizma koju je tražio. Unatoč dubokoj ljubavi prema djevojci, oboje su prepoznali da je njegov poziv jači i da će Bog providjeti najbolje za oboje.

magisterium.assessment: Opis razlučivanja celibata kroz iskustvo i želju za prenošenjem vjere u potpunosti je u skladu s katoličkim naukom o pozivu.
magisterium.enrichment: Celibat se u Crkvi časti kao slobodan izbor radi Kraljevstva Božjeg, a razlučivanje uključuje usklađivanje osobnih želja s Božjim pozivom (KKC 1580).
magisterium.assessment_en: The description of the discernment of celibacy through experience and the desire for transmitting the faith is fully in accordance with Catholic teaching on vocation.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Celibacy is honored in the Church as a free choice for the sake of the Kingdom of God, and discernment includes aligning personal desires with God's call (CCC 1580).

sections.subtitle_en: Past relationships and the call to celibacy
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav talks about his past relationships and how he understood the call to celibacy.
sections.content_en: Don Tomislav speaks openly about his past relationships, mentioning two more serious ones. Although he was deeply in love in one and could imagine a future with that girl, something was always missing for him. From an early age, he felt a strong desire to transmit the faith to children and young people, but he did not see a concrete path for this within the diocesan priesthood of that time. The key moment occurred in the third grade of high school when a female friend introduced him to a Salesian priest. That priest, who actively worked with young people, became the embodiment of his desire. Don Tomislav realized that the Salesians are priests dedicated to working with children and young people, which was the charism he was looking for. Despite his deep love for the girl, both recognized that his vocation was stronger and that God would provide the best for both of them.

sections.subtitle: Vjenčanje bivše djevojke i razumijevanje celibata
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav priča o vjenčanju svoje bivše djevojke i kako je to utjecalo na njegovo razumijevanje celibata.
sections.content: U iznenađujućem obratu, Don Tomislav otkriva da je prošle godine vjenčao svoju bivšu djevojku. Ovaj događaj, iako emotivan, dodatno je potvrdio njegov poziv. Objašnjava da, iako je iskusio ljepotu ženske ljubavi, Bog ga je pozvao na nešto drugačije – da njegovo srce bude podjednako za sve, poput Isusovog. Celibat, prema njegovim riječima, nije odricanje od ljubavi, već drugačiji način ljubavi i služenja. Smatra da svećenici, živeći celibat, svjedoče o nebeskoj stvarnosti i podsjećaju bračne parove da je njihov cilj svetost i nebo, a ne samo zemaljska sreća. Ističe komplementarnost braka i svećeništva, oba puta vodeći prema svetosti.

magisterium.assessment: Don Tomislav ispravno tumači celibat kao dar i način ljubavi, a ne kao puko odricanje, što je u potpunosti u skladu s katoličkim naukom.
magisterium.enrichment: Celibat za kraljevstvo nebesko nije negacija ljubavi, već njezino usmjeravanje prema univerzalnom očinstvu, čime svećenik postaje znak novog života u Kristu.
magisterium.assessment_en: Don Tomislav correctly interprets celibacy as a gift and a way of love, and not as mere renunciation, which is completely in accordance with Catholic teaching.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Celibacy for the kingdom of heaven is not a negation of love, but its directing towards universal fatherhood, by which the priest becomes a sign of new life in Christ.

sections.subtitle_en: Wedding of an ex-girlfriend and understanding celibacy
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav talks about the wedding of his ex-girlfriend and how that affected his understanding of celibacy.
sections.content_en: In a surprising turn, Don Tomislav reveals that last year he married his former girlfriend. This event, although emotional, additionally confirmed his vocation. He explains that, although he experienced the beauty of a woman's love, God called him to something different – that his heart be equally for everyone, like Jesus's. Celibacy, according to his words, is not a renunciation of love, but a different way of love and service. He considers that priests, living celibacy, witness to heavenly reality and remind married couples that their goal is holiness and heaven, and not only earthly happiness. He emphasizes the complementarity of marriage and priesthood, both paths leading toward holiness.

sections.subtitle: Celibat kao duhovno očinstvo
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav objašnjava celibat kao duhovno očinstvo.
sections.content: Don Tomislav Lukač produbljuje temu celibata, naglašavajući da je to jednako vrijedan i lijep poziv, ali drugačiji od bračnog. Tvrdi da je Isus, kao potpuno čovjek i muškarac, sigurno osjećao privlačnost prema ženama, ali je njegovo poslanje zahtijevalo da njegovo srce bude podjednako za sve. Svećenici žive to isto poslanje. Don Tomislav smatra da je celibat težak samo onima koji nisu potpuno predani molitvi i koji se ne osjećaju plodno u svom duhovnom očinstvu. On sam se osjeća ispunjenim kao duhovni otac tisućama djece i mladih, što mu pruža duboku radost i smisao. Biološko očinstvo je, kaže, lako postići, dok je duhovno očinstvo, koje uključuje odgajanje u vjeri i darivanje Boga, puno teže i obogaćujuće. Ponovno ističe da nije postao svećenik jer ne voli žene ili ne može imati vezu, već zato što ga je Bog pozvao na nešto drugo, dajući mu snagu za to. Ljudi se, zaključuje, ne bi trebali svoditi na životinjske instinkte, jer se ljubav može izraziti na mnogo načina.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak ispravno naglašava duhovno očinstvo i celibat kao poziv koji zahtijeva potpuno predanje Bogu, što je u skladu s crkvenom tradicijom.
magisterium.enrichment: Svećenički celibat omogućuje svećeniku da se 'nepodijeljenim srcem' posveti Gospodinu i njegovim poslovima, postajući tako otac mnogima u duhovnom smislu.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage correctly emphasizes spiritual fatherhood and celibacy as a vocation that requires complete surrender to God, which is in accordance with Church tradition.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Priestly celibacy enables the priest to dedicate himself with an 'undivided heart' to the Lord and his affairs, thus becoming a father to many in a spiritual sense.

sections.subtitle_en: Celibacy as spiritual fatherhood
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav explains celibacy as spiritual fatherhood.
sections.content_en: Don Tomislav Lukač deepens the theme of celibacy, emphasizing that it is an equally valuable and beautiful calling, but different from the marital one. He claims that Jesus, as fully human and a man, certainly felt attraction towards women, but his mission required that his heart be equally for everyone. Priests live this same mission. Don Tomislav considers that celibacy is difficult only to those who are not fully committed to prayer and who do not feel fruitful in their spiritual fatherhood. He himself feels fulfilled as a spiritual father to thousands of children and young people, which provides him with deep joy and meaning. Biological fatherhood is, he says, easy to achieve, while spiritual fatherhood, which includes raising in the faith and giving God, is much more difficult and enriching. He emphasizes again that he did not become a priest because he does not love women or cannot have a relationship, but because God called him to something else, giving him the strength for it. People, he concludes, should not reduce themselves to animal instincts, because love can be expressed in many ways.

sections.subtitle: Razlučivanje Božjih znakova i uloga molitve
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav objašnjava kako razlučiti Božje znakove i važnost molitve.
sections.content: Na pitanje kako razlučiti Božje znakove od vlastitih želja, Don Tomislav Lukač jasno odgovara: **molitva je jedini odgovor**. Uspoređuje odnos s Bogom s vezom između dvoje ljudi – što je odnos dublji, to je razumijevanje suptilnije. Savjetuje da se nijedan znak ne promatra izolirano, već da se svi događaji donesu pred Boga u osobnoj molitvi, tražeći potvrdu. Ključno je i razmisliti hoće li određena odluka donijeti **pravi mir**, što je snažan pokazatelj Božje volje. Iako Bog daje znakove, uvijek ostavlja prostor za slobodu izbora, nikada ne dajući stopostotnu sigurnost. Don Tomislav objašnjava da se 'slagalica' poziva postupno slaže kako se osoba kreće naprijed, a ne prije samog početka. Kombinacija osluškivanja Boga i slobodne odluke je dobitna kombinacija.

magisterium.assessment: Savjet o molitvi kao jedinom putu razlučivanja u potpunosti je usklađen s katoličkom duhovnom tradicijom i praksom.
magisterium.enrichment: Razlučivanje zahtijeva poniznost i stavljanje vlastitih želja pred Boga, kako bi se prepoznala Njegova volja, a ne samo vlastite projekcije.
magisterium.assessment_en: The advice on prayer as the only path of discernment is fully aligned with Catholic spiritual tradition and practice.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Discernment requires humility and placing one's own desires before God, in order to recognize His will, and not only one's own projections.

sections.subtitle_en: Discernment of God's signs and the role of prayer
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav explains how to discern God's signs and the importance of prayer.
sections.content_en: To the question of how to discern God's signs from one's own desires, Don Tomislav Lukač clearly answers: **prayer is the only answer**. He compares the relationship with God to a relationship between two people – the deeper the relationship, the subtler the understanding. He advises that no sign should be observed in isolation, but rather that all events be brought before God in personal prayer, seeking confirmation. It is also crucial to consider whether a certain decision will bring **true peace**, which is a strong indicator of God's will. Although God gives signs, He always leaves room for freedom of choice, never giving one hundred percent certainty. Don Tomislav explains that the 'puzzle' of the calling is put together gradually as a person moves forward, and not before the very beginning. The combination of listening to God and free decision is a winning combination.

sections.subtitle: Sotonin utjecaj u vjerskom sadržaju i crkvenom autoritetu
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav govori o opasnostima Sotoninog utjecaja u vjerskom sadržaju i crkvenim autoritetima.
sections.content:
Don Tomislav Lukač upozorava na opasnost Sotoninog djelovanja kroz vjerski sadržaj, posebno na društvenim mrežama. Savjetuje da se oprezno pristupa sadržaju koji nije provjeren i potvrđen od strane Crkve – Pape, crkvenih dokumenata i Katekizma. Ističe da, za razliku od tisuća sekti i protestantskih denominacija, postoji samo jedna Katolička Crkva s jedinstvenim autoritetom Pape, koji jamči istinitost nauka. Iako Duh Sveti djeluje i kroz protestante, njihove interpretacije mogu biti pogrešne ili nepotpune. Kao primjer navodi svetog Ignacija Antiohijskog, učenika apostola Ivana, čije je tumačenje Evanđelja autentičnije od modernih, neprovjerenih interpretacija.

Kada je riječ o crkvenim autoritetima, Don Tomislav priznaje da i oni mogu pogriješiti ili biti nejasni u svojim izjavama, što Sotona može iskoristiti za sijanje razdora i zbunjenosti. Naglašava da papinska nepogrešivost nije apsolutna, već se odnosi na specifična dogmatska i moralna pitanja. Poručuje da svećenici i drugi autoriteti trebaju nuditi ljudima ono što ima 'crkvenu garanciju', a ne samo osobna mišljenja, kako bi se izbjegle zablude i zaštitila vjera vjernika.

magisterium.assessment: Naglašavanje važnosti crkvenog autoriteta i provjere sadržaja kroz Katekizam i crkvene dokumente ključno je za očuvanje vjere.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveno učiteljstvo, pod vodstvom Pape i biskupa, ima zadaću autentičnog tumačenja Riječi Božje i zaštite vjernika od zabluda.
magisterium.assessment_en: Emphasizing the importance of church authority and the verification of content through the Catechism and church documents is crucial for the preservation of faith.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church's Magisterium, under the leadership of the Pope and bishops, has the task of authentic interpretation of the Word of God and protection of the faithful from errors.

sections.subtitle_en: Satan's influence in religious content and church authority
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav speaks about the dangers of Satan's influence in religious content and church authorities.
sections.content_en:
Don Tomislav Lukač warns of the danger of Satan's action through religious content, especially on social networks. He advises to cautiously approach content that is not verified and confirmed by the Church – the Pope, church documents, and the Catechism. He points out that, unlike thousands of sects and Protestant denominations, there is only one Catholic Church with the unique authority of the Pope, who guarantees the truth of the teaching. Although the Holy Spirit acts also through Protestants, their interpretations can be wrong or incomplete. As an example, he cites Saint Ignacije Antiohijski, a disciple of the apostle Ivan, whose interpretation of the Gospel is more authentic than modern, unverified interpretations.

When it comes to church authorities, Don Tomislav admits that they too can make mistakes or be unclear in their statements, which Satan can use to sow discord and confusion. He emphasizes that papal infallibility is not absolute, but refers to specific dogmatic and moral questions. He says that priests and other authorities should offer people what has a 'church guarantee', and not just personal opinions, in order to avoid delusions and protect the faith of the believers.

iterations.theme: Strategije evangelizacije i mudrost u odnosima

sections.subtitle: Don Boscov pristup: Kako doprijeti do mladih tamo gdje jesu
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo igra nogomet s djecom u Liskovači, pokazujući Don Boscov pristup evangelizaciji.
sections.content:
Don Tomislav Lukač ističe važnost evangelizacije mladih koristeći pristup svetog Ivana Bosca, koji je zagovarao "propovijedanje evanđelja u novom ruhu". Objašnjava kako je njegov angažman na društvenim mrežama, poput TikToka i Instagrama, upravo to – način da se približi mladima tamo gdje jesu i potakne ih da dođu u Crkvu.

Don Tomo dijeli konkretna iskustva gdje su njegovi videozapisi potaknuli mlade na ispovijed, redovitije pohađanje mise, pa čak i na odluku za predbračnu čistoću. Naglašava da video sam po sebi ne mijenja život, ali može biti poticaj za korak koji će to učiniti.

Prisjeća se i anegdote iz svog rodnog sela Liskovače, gdje je nakon mise zaigrao nogomet s djecom. Taj jednostavan čin, gdje im je bio "blizu" kroz nešto što vole, doveo je do toga da su ga djeca kasnije zamolila za blagoslov i savjet kako biti dobri nogometaši i vjernici. Don Tomo to vidi kao savršen primjer Don Boscovog načela: "Volite stvari koje mladi vole da bi oni zavolili ono što vi volite." Kroz takav pristup, nogomet je postao most do blagoslova i mini-propovijedi, ostavljajući trajan dojam na mlade.

magisterium.assessment: Pristup don Ivana Bosca, koji naglašava susret s mladima u njihovom okruženju ('tamo gdje jesu'), u potpunosti je usklađen s katoličkom tradicijom evangelizacije.
magisterium.enrichment: Sveti Ivan Bosco je koristio suvremene metode svog vremena (igre, zabavu) kako bi privukao mlade Kristu, što je temelj njegove preventivne metode odgoja. Crkva potiče korištenje svih sredstava za naviještanje Evanđelja, pod uvjetom da se zadrži integritet poruke.
magisterium.assessment_en: The approach of don Ivan Bosco, which emphasizes the encounter with young people in their environment ('there where they are'), is fully aligned with the Catholic tradition of evangelization.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Saint John Bosco used contemporary methods of his time (games, entertainment) in order to attract the youth to Christ, which is the foundation of his preventive method of education. The Church encourages the use of all means for proclaiming the Gospel, provided that the integrity of the message is maintained.

sections.subtitle_en: Don Bosco's approach: How to reach young people where they are
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo plays football with children in Liskovača, showing Don Bosco's approach to evangelization.
sections.content_en:
Don Tomislav Lukač emphasizes the importance of the evangelization of youth using the approach of Saint John Bosco, who advocated "preaching the Gospel in a new garb." He explains how his engagement on social networks, like TikTok and Instagram, is precisely that – a way to get closer to young people where they are and encourage them to come to Church.

Don Tomo shares concrete experiences where his videos encouraged young people to confession, more regular attendance of Mass, and even to a decision for premarital chastity. He emphasizes that a video in itself does not change a life, but it can be an incentive for a step that will do so.

He also recalls an anecdote from his native village of Liskovača, where after Mass he played soccer with the children. That simple act, where he was "close" to them through something they love, led to the children later asking him for a blessing and advice on how to be good soccer players and believers. Don Tomo sees this as a perfect example of Don Bosco's principle: "Love things that young people love so that they would love what you love." Through such an approach, soccer became a bridge to a blessing and a mini-sermon, leaving a lasting impression on the youth.

sections.subtitle: Više od lajkova: Biti autentični "influencer" za Krista
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo govori o važnosti poznavanja Boga, a ne samo biti jak.
sections.content:
Iva postavlja pitanje o tome kako mladi trebaju svjedočiti svoju vjeru, pogotovo u okruženjima gdje to može biti izazovno. Don Tomislav Lukač odgovara da je prvi korak biti zahvalan na onome što jesu i što imaju, povezujući hrvatsku riječ "bogat" s "Bogom" – bogat je onaj tko ima Boga u životu. Ističe važnost ponosa na katoličku vjeru i želje da se ona podijeli s drugima, uspoređujući to s preporukom dobrog restorana. Ako je nešto dobro i važno, prirodno je da to želimo podijeliti.

Don Tomo podsjeća na Isusove riječi: "Budite svjetlo svijeta, budite sol zemlje" i "Idite po svem svijetu, navješćujte evanđelje." Naglašava da te riječi nisu upućene samo svećenicima ili takozvanim "katoličkim influencerima", već svakome. "Svatko je pozvan biti influencer," kaže, "u pravom smislu, influencer da dovede druge Bogu." Ključna poruka je: **"Ne traži biti jak, traži poznavat jakoga."** To znači govoriti o onome što Bog čini u životu, a ne o vlastitim sposobnostima. Svjedočenje treba biti s ljubavlju, bez osuđivanja, uz poznavanje katoličke vjere i sposobnost argumentiranog odgovora na pitanja. Citira svetog Franju Asiškog: "Navješćujte evanđelje ako je potrebno i riječima," ističući da je životno svjedočanstvo najvažnije.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na autentičnom svjedočenju životom i ponosu na vjeru u potpunosti je u skladu s crkvenim naukom o apostolatu laika.
magisterium.enrichment: Katekizam Katoličke Crkve (KKC 905, 2044) ističe da je svjedočanstvo kršćanskog života primarni uvjet za evangelizaciju. Biti 'bogat' Bogom odražava biblijsku mudrost o istinskom blagu koje ne prolazi.
magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis on authentic witnessing by life and pride in faith is completely in accordance with Church teaching on the apostolate of the laity.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catechism of the Catholic Church (CCC 905, 2044) emphasizes that the witness of Christian life is the primary condition for evangelization. Being 'rich' in God reflects biblical wisdom about the true treasure that does not pass away.

sections.subtitle_en: More than likes: Being an authentic "influencer" for Christ
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo speaks about the importance of knowing God, and not only being strong.
sections.content_en:
Iva asks a question about how young people should witness their faith, especially in environments where it can be challenging. Don Tomislav Lukač responds that the first step is to be grateful for what they are and what they have, connecting the Croatian word "rich" with "God" – rich is the one who has God in life. He emphasizes the importance of pride in the Catholic faith and the desire to share it with others, comparing it to the recommendation of a good restaurant. If something is good and important, it is natural that we want to share it.

Don Tomo recalls Jesus' words: "Be the light of the world, be the salt of the earth" and "Go into all the world, proclaim the gospel." He emphasizes that these words are not addressed only to priests or so-called "Catholic influencers", but to everyone. "Everyone is called to be an influencer," he says, "in the true sense, an influencer to bring others to God." The key message is: **"Do not seek to be strong, seek to know the strong one."** This means speaking about what God is doing in life, and not about one's own abilities. Witnessing should be with love, without judgment, along with knowledge of the Catholic faith and the ability to give a reasoned answer to questions. He quotes Saint Francis of Assisi: "Proclaim the gospel, if necessary, also with words," emphasizing that the witness of life is the most important.

sections.subtitle: Sol zemlje i gnojivo: Kako balansirati vjeru i društvene krugove
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo objašnjava metaforu gnojiva, naglašavajući važnost širenja vjere, a ne izolacije.
sections.content:
Na pitanje o tome treba li se vjernik povući iz društva u kojem je jedini vjernik ili je pozvan evangelizirati, Don Tomislav Lukač nudi savjet svetog Ivana Bosca. Prema Don Boscu, ako osoba može pozitivno utjecati na društvo, treba ostati. Međutim, ako loše društvo počinje negativno utjecati na vjernika više nego što on pozitivno utječe na njih, tada se treba maknuti.

Don Tomo naglašava da se katolici ne smiju izolirati. Koristi snažne metafore: "Ne možete posoliti nešto ako sol stoji na hrpi" i "Gnojivo kad je na hrpi smrdi. Kad ga prospeš, daje plod." Ove usporedbe ilustriraju da vjera mora biti aktivna i širiti se, a ne ostati zatvorena u uskim krugovima istomišljenika. Potrebno je pronaći balans – biti mudar, ne dopustiti da te društvo povuče na svoju stranu, ali se ni ne izolirati. Ponekad je vjernik jedino "evanđelje" koje će netko pročitati. Zajednica vjernika pruža snagu, ali ta snaga služi za odlazak u svijet i evangelizaciju, baš kao što je Isus prvo okupio apostole, a zatim ih poslao "dvoje po dvoje" da šire Radosnu vijest.

magisterium.assessment: Savjet o razlučivanju utjecaja društva na vjernika odražava razboritost i brigu za duhovno zdravlje, što je u skladu s kršćanskom mudrošću.
magisterium.enrichment: Kršćanin je pozvan biti 'sol zemlje', ali i čuvati vlastitu vjeru od negativnih utjecaja. Razlučivanje između apostolskog djelovanja i izlaganja duhovnoj opasnosti ključno je za duhovni rast.
magisterium.assessment_en: The advice on discerning the influence of society on the believer reflects prudence and care for spiritual health, which is in accordance with Christian wisdom.
magisterium.enrichment_en: A Christian is called to be the 'salt of the earth', but also to guard their own faith from negative influences. Discernment between apostolic activity and exposure to spiritual danger is crucial for spiritual growth.

sections.subtitle_en: Salt of the earth and fertilizer: How to balance faith and social circles
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo explains the metaphor of fertilizer, emphasizing the importance of spreading the faith, and not isolation.
sections.content_en:
To the question of whether a believer should withdraw from the company in which he is the only believer or is called to evangelize, Don Tomislav Lukač offers the advice of Saint John Bosco. According to Don Bosco, if a person can positively influence the company, they should remain. However, if bad company begins to negatively influence the believer more than he positively influences them, then he should withdraw.

Don Tomo emphasizes that Catholics must not isolate themselves. He uses powerful metaphors: "You cannot salt something if the salt stands in a pile" and "Fertilizer when it is in a pile stinks. When you scatter it, it yields fruit." These comparisons illustrate that faith must be active and spread, and not remain closed in narrow circles of like-minded people. It is necessary to find a balance – to be wise, not to allow the company to pull you to its side, but also not to isolate oneself. Sometimes a believer is the only "gospel" that someone will read. The community of believers provides strength, but that strength serves for going into the world and evangelization, just as Jesus first gathered the apostles, and then sent them "two by two" to spread the Good News.

sections.subtitle: Vjera u braku: Molitva, post i izazovi mješovitih zajednica
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo govori o ustrajnosti svete Monike u molitvi i postu za svog sina Augustina.
sections.content:
Na pitanje slušateljice kako potaknuti vjeru u suprugu koji nije veliki vjernik, Don Tomislav Lukač ističe da se često susreće s ovim problemom u ispovijedima i razgovorima. Ohrabruje suprugu da nastavi s molitvom i postom za svog muža, podsjećajući na Isusove riječi da se "neki zlodusi ne izgone samo molitvom nego molitvom i postom." Kao primjer ustrajnosti navodi svetu Moniku, koja je 30 godina molila i postila za svog sina Augustina, koji je kasnije postao svetac.

Don Tomo spominje i riječi svetog Pavla da vjernica posvećuje nevjernog muža, naglašavajući da je to moguće. Iako Crkva priznaje mješovite brakove (s muslimanima, ateistima), ističe da su oni izuzetno teški. Vjera je prebitan element katoličkog braka, koji je savez sklopljen pred Isusom i križem, obećanje da će se ljubiti "dok nas smrt ne rastavi". Musliman ili ateist neće izreći takvo obećanje niti će ga živjeti u istom duhovnom smislu. Cilj života je svetost, a u braku je to dovesti jedno drugo i djecu u nebo, što je teško postići bez zajedničke vjere. Djeca također pate zbog podijeljenosti roditelja po pitanju vjere. Don Tomo zaključuje da "ljubav" i "klik" nisu dovoljni za dubinu katoličkog braka, koji ima mnogo veću vrijednost.

magisterium.assessment: Preporuka molitve i posta za supružnika te primjer svete Monike u potpunosti su utemeljeni na Svetom pismu i tradiciji.
magisterium.enrichment: Isusove riječi o molitvi i postu (Mk 9,29) temelj su duhovne borbe. Sveta Monika je uzor ustrajne molitve za obraćenje, što je snažan primjer kršćanske nade i ljubavi.
magisterium.assessment_en: The recommendation of prayer and fasting for a spouse and the example of Saint Monica are completely founded on Sacred Scripture and tradition.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Jesus' words about prayer and fasting (Mk 9:29) are the foundation of spiritual struggle. Saint Monica is a model of persevering prayer for conversion, which is a powerful example of Christian hope and love.

sections.subtitle_en: Faith in marriage: Prayer, fasting and challenges of mixed communities
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo speaks about the perseverance of Saint Monica in prayer and fasting for her son Augustine.
sections.content_en: To the question of a female listener on how to encourage faith in a husband who is not a great believer, Don Tomislav Lukač points out that he often encounters this problem in confessions and conversations. He encourages the wife to continue with prayer and fasting for her husband, recalling Jesus' words that "some demons are not cast out only by prayer but by prayer and fasting." As an example of perseverance, he cites Saint Monika, who prayed and fasted for 30 years for her son Augustin, who later became a saint. Don Tomo also mentions the words of Saint Pavao that a believing wife sanctifies an unbelieving husband, emphasizing that this is possible. Although the Church recognizes mixed marriages (with Muslims, atheists), he points out that they are extremely difficult. Faith is an extremely important element of a Catholic marriage, which is a covenant made before Jesus and the cross, a promise to love each other "until death do us part." A Muslim or an atheist will not make such a promise, nor will they live it in the same spiritual sense. The goal of life is holiness, and in marriage it is to bring each other and the children to heaven, which is difficult to achieve without a common faith. Children also suffer because of the division of parents on the issue of faith. Don Tomo concludes that "love" and "click" are not enough for the depth of a Catholic marriage, which has a much greater value.

sections.subtitle: Ljubav kao odluka: Razbijanje mita o srodnim dušama
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo objašnjava grčki mit o srodnim dušama i zašto je to pogrešno shvaćanje ljubavi.
sections.content:
Don Tomislav Lukač se osvrće na problem mladih žena koje se zaljubljuju u muslimane ili ateiste, a zatim se suočavaju s vjerskim preprekama. Objašnjava da je ideja "srodnih duša" zapravo grčki mit o androgynu, biću koje je Bog podijelio na muško i žensko, a koje cijeli život traži svoju drugu polovicu. Don Tomo naglašava da je to pogrešno shvaćanje ljubavi, jer Bog nam daje slobodu izbora i ne postoji samo jedna osoba na svijetu s kojom možemo biti sretni. Ako nas netko odbije, nismo osuđeni na vječnu nesreću, već postoji mnogo ljudi s kojima možemo izgraditi brak i rasti u svetosti.

Iva se nadovezuje, ističući da perspektiva "srodnih duša" i oslanjanje na kemiju zanemaruje ključni faktor: **ljubav je odluka, i to svakodnevna.** Spominje trend u Americi gdje se bračni zavjeti mijenjaju u "dok naša ljubav traje," što dovodi do lakog prekida odnosa kada osjećaji izblijede. Don Tomo se slaže, naglašavajući da je brak savez, a ne ugovor. Savez podrazumijeva bezuvjetnu ljubav i predanost, poput Kristove ljubavi na križu, koja nije bila vođena emocijama, već odlukom.

Kritizira nedovoljnu pripremu za brak, uspoređujući desetogodišnju svećeničku formaciju s pet večeri bračnih tečajeva.
