Ističe da se ljubav razvija kroz faze: od zaljubljenosti (koja je često usmjerena na sebe), preko prihvaćanja mana, do duhovne faze gdje se život daje za drugoga. Upozorava da preuranjeno fokusiranje na tjelesno može zamagliti prosudbu i spriječiti dublje upoznavanje partnera, što kasnije dovodi do problema u braku. Tjelesnost bi trebala biti potvrda duhovne povezanosti i zavjeta, a ne temelj odnosa.

magisterium.assessment: Izvrsno usklađeno s kršćanskim poimanjem ljubavi kao čina volje i sebedarja, a ne samo emocije.
magisterium.enrichment: Kršćanska ljubav (agape) temelji se na slobodnom izboru i predanju, po uzoru na Krista koji je dao život za svoje prijatelje (Iv 15,13). Sveti Pavao u 1. Korinćanima 13 naglašava da je ljubav strpljiva i dobrostiva, što zahtijeva svjesnu odluku, a ne samo osjećaj.
magisterium.assessment_en: Excellently aligned with the Christian understanding of love as an act of the will and self-giving, and not just an emotion.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Christian love (agape) is based on free choice and surrender, after the model of Christ who gave his life for his friends (Jn 15:13). Saint Paul in 1 Corinthians 13 emphasizes that love is patient and kind, which requires a conscious decision, and not just a feeling.

sections.subtitle_en: Love as a Decision: Shattering the Myth of Soulmates
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo explains the Greek myth about soulmates and why that is a mistaken understanding of love.
sections.content_en:
Don Tomislav Lukač reflects on the problem of young women who fall in love with Muslims or atheists, and then face religious obstacles. He explains that the idea of "soulmates" is actually a Greek myth about the androgyne, a being that God divided into male and female, and which searches for its other half its whole life. Don Tomo emphasizes that this is a wrong understanding of love, because God gives us freedom of choice and there is not only one person in the world with whom we can be happy. If someone rejects us, we are not condemned to eternal unhappiness, but there are many people with whom we can build a marriage and grow in holiness.

Iva adds, pointing out that the perspective of "soulmates" and relying on chemistry ignores a key factor: **love is a decision, and a daily one at that.** She mentions a trend in America where marriage vows are changed to "as long as our love lasts," which leads to an easy breakup of the relationship when feelings fade. Don Tomo agrees, emphasizing that marriage is a covenant, not a contract. A covenant implies unconditional love and commitment, like Christ's love on the cross, which was not guided by emotions, but by a decision.

He criticizes the insufficient preparation for marriage, comparing the ten-year priestly formation with five evenings of marriage courses. He points out that love develops through phases: from falling in love (which is often focused on oneself), through accepting flaws, to the spiritual phase where life is given for the other. He warns that premature focusing on the physical can cloud judgment and prevent getting to know the partner more deeply, which later leads to problems in marriage. Physicality should be a confirmation of spiritual connection and vows, and not the foundation of a relationship.

sections.subtitle: Predbračna čistoća: Put do autentične ljubavi i dublje povezanosti
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo objašnjava kako je par shvatio da im tjelesna intimnost bez braka stvara osjećaj laži i uzimanja nečega što im ne pripada.
sections.content:
Iva primjećuje da se predbračna čistoća čini kao "preporod" među mladima, možda kao alternativa dominantnim trendovima. Don Tomislav Lukač izražava nadu da to neće ostati samo alternativa, već da će postati mainstream. Iva dijeli primjer para koji je, nakon što je počeo prakticirati predbračnu čistoću, shvatio da nemaju ništa drugo zajedničko i prekinuo vezu, jer su bili prisiljeni upoznati se na dubljoj razini.

Don Tomo zatim priča o paru koji je, nakon njegove propovijedi, odlučio živjeti predbračnu čistoću. Iako su živjeli zajedno i imali redovite intimne odnose, osjećali su da nešto nije u redu. Žena je izjavila da se nakon svakog odnosa osjećala kao da se međusobno lažu, jer su tijelima govorili "tvoj sam potpuno," a još se nisu vjenčali. Muškarac je, još snažnije, rekao da se osjećao kao da "uzima nešto što još nije njegovo."

Ovo svjedočanstvo Don Tomo koristi kako bi objasnio vrijednost predbračne čistoće. Par je želio živjeti po Božjoj volji, vjerujući da On zna što je najbolje za njih, iako u tom trenutku nisu znali za koncept predbračne čistoće. Nakon što su shvatili da postoji bolji put, prvo su prestali spavati zajedno, zatim su se čak i odvojili, da bi se na kraju vjenčali. Njihova priča pokazuje hrabrost da budu iskreni prema sebi i da traže autentičnu povezanost koja nadilazi samo tjelesno, vodeći do dublje i istinskije ljubavi.

magisterium.assessment: Potpuno usklađeno s crkvenim naukom o čistoći kao vrlini koja štiti dostojanstvo osobe i priprema za sakrament ženidbe.
magisterium.enrichment: Katekizam Katoličke Crkve (2350) ističe da zaručnici trebaju vidjeti vrijeme zaruka kao otkrivanje uzajamnog poštovanja i vježbanje u vjernosti. Čistoća omogućuje dublje upoznavanje osobe, izbjegavajući objektifikaciju koja je protivna Božjoj volji (1 Sol 4,3-5).
magisterium.assessment_en: Fully aligned with Church teaching on chastity as a virtue that protects the dignity of the person and prepares for the sacrament of marriage.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catechism of the Catholic Church (2350) emphasizes that engaged couples should see the time of engagement as a discovery of mutual respect and practice in fidelity. Chastity enables a deeper knowing of the person, avoiding objectification which is contrary to God's will (1 Thess 4:3-5).

sections.subtitle_en: Premarital chastity: The path to authentic love and deeper connection
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo explains how the couple realized that physical intimacy without marriage creates for them a feeling of a lie and of taking something that does not belong to them.
sections.content_en:
Iva notices that premarital chastity seems like a "revival" among young people, perhaps as an alternative to dominant trends. Don Tomislav Lukač expresses hope that this will not remain only an alternative, but that it will become mainstream. Iva shares an example of a couple who, after they started practicing premarital chastity, realized that they had nothing else in common and broke up the relationship, because they were forced to get to know each other on a deeper level.

Don Tomo then talks about a couple who, after his sermon, decided to live premarital chastity. Although they lived together and had regular intimate relations, they felt that something was not right. The woman stated that after every relation she felt as if they were lying to each other, because with their bodies they were saying "I am completely yours," and they had not yet married. The man, even more strongly, said that he felt as if he was "taking something that is not yet his."

Don Tomo uses this testimony to explain the value of premarital chastity. The couple wanted to live according to God's will, believing that He knows what is best for them, although at that moment they did not know about the concept of premarital chastity. After they realized that there is a better way, first they stopped sleeping together, then they even separated, only to marry in the end. Their story shows the courage to be honest with themselves and to seek an authentic connection that transcends only the physical, leading to a deeper and truer love.

sections.subtitle: Euharistija: Srce vjere i odgovor na vječno pitanje 'Zašto crkva?'
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo objašnjava važnost Euharistije i zašto je odlazak u crkvu ključan za vjernike.
sections.content:
Don Tomo se osvrće na često postavljano pitanje zašto je potrebno ići u crkvu, a ne moliti se samo kod kuće. Naglašava da je Euharistija vrhunac katoličke vjere i da je Isus Krist stvarno prisutan u njoj, a ne samo simbolično. Koristi snažnu usporedbu s majčinim rođendanom: ako majka želi da počistite kuću, a vi joj umjesto toga kupite čokoladu, niste ispunili njezinu želju, iako je volite. Slično tome, Isus je jasno rekao: 'Ovo činite meni na spomen' i 'Tko ne blaguje od mojega tijela, nema život vječni'. Stoga, izbjegavanje mise znači nepoštivanje Isusove izričite želje, što ukazuje na manju ljubav prema Njemu.

Don Tomo također ističe da nedostojnost svećenika ne umanjuje vrijednost Euharistije. Podsjeća na priču o svetom Franji Asiškom, koji je, upitan bi li primio pričest od svećenika koji posjećuje javne kuće, odgovorio potvrdno, dodavši da bi mu čak i ruke poljubio. Ova priča naglašava da je Božja milost veća od ljudskih slabosti i da nijedan svećenik, ma koliko bio loš, ne može spriječiti vjernika da primi živog Isusa u Euharistiji. Crkva je mjesto gdje je Isus stvarno prisutan, a ne samo simbolično, što je ključna razlika i razlog zašto mnogi odlaze od Njega, ne vjerujući u Njegovu stvarnu prisutnost.

magisterium.assessment: Teološki precizno i vjerno nauku o stvarnoj prisutnosti Krista u Euharistiji.
magisterium.enrichment: Euharistija je vrhunac kršćanskog života (KKC 1374). Crkva naučava da je Krist stvarno, bitno i supstancijalno prisutan pod prilikama kruha i vina, što zahtijeva naše klanjanje i sudjelovanje u liturgiji (KKC 1378).
magisterium.assessment_en: Theologically precise and faithful to the teaching on the real presence of Christ in the Eucharist.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Eucharist is the summit of Christian life (CCC 1374). The Church teaches that Christ is really, essentially, and substantially present under the appearances of bread and wine, which requires our adoration and participation in the liturgy (CCC 1378).

sections.subtitle_en: Eucharist: Heart of faith and answer to the eternal question 'Why the church?'
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo explains the importance of the Eucharist and why going to church is crucial for believers.
sections.content_en:
Don Tomo reflects on the frequently asked question of why it is necessary to go to church, and not just pray at home. He emphasizes that the Eucharist is the summit of the Catholic faith and that Jesus Christ is truly present in it, and not just symbolically. He uses a powerful comparison with a mother's birthday: if a mother wants you to clean the house, and instead you buy her a chocolate, you have not fulfilled her wish, although you love her. Similarly, Jesus clearly said: 'Do this in memory of me' and 'Whoever does not eat of my body does not have eternal life'. Therefore, avoiding Mass means disrespecting Jesus' explicit wish, which indicates a lesser love for Him.

Don Tomo also points out that the unworthiness of the priest does not diminish the value of the Eucharist. He recalls the story of Saint Francis of Assisi, who, when asked if he would receive communion from a priest who visits brothels, answered in the affirmative, adding that he would even kiss his hands. This story emphasizes that God's grace is greater than human weaknesses and that no priest, no matter how bad he may be, can prevent a believer from receiving the living Jesus in the Eucharist. The Church is the place where Jesus is truly present, and not just symbolically, which is the key difference and the reason why many leave Him, not believing in His real presence.

sections.subtitle: Suočavanje s 'hejterima': Izazovi digitalne evangelizacije
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo govori o svojim iskustvima s negativnim komentarima i kritikama na društvenim mrežama.
sections.content:
Voditeljica Iva pita Don Tomu kako se nosi s 'hejterima' na društvenim mrežama. Don Tomo s osmijehom odgovara da mu je drago što ih ima, podsjećajući na Isusove riječi da će Njegovi sljedbenici biti progonjeni. Objašnjava da se kritike uglavnom odnose na dvije skupine ljudi. Prva su oni koji ne vole Boga, vjeru i svećenike, a druga su 'veliki katolici' ili 'katolibani' koji smatraju da svećenikovo mjesto nije na društvenim mrežama, već u crkvi.

Don Tomo priznaje da su ga na početku uvredljivi komentari pogađali, ali je s vremenom razvio strategiju: ograničava vrijeme provedeno čitajući komentare i moli za svoje kritičare. Zanimljivo je da su većina 'hejtera' odrasli ljudi koji se skrivaju iza pseudonima, dok su djeca i mladi, kojima je prvenstveno namijenjen njegov sadržaj, uglavnom pozitivni. Ističe da mu je najveća radost kada mu se jave ljudi koji su se udaljili od Crkve ili oni koji nisu katolici (muslimani, pravoslavci, ateisti) i izraze zahvalnost ili želju za učenjem o vjeri. To potvrđuje njegovu misiju da dopre do 'najrubnijih i najsiromašnijih' – onih koji su siromašni Bogom. Smatra da crkvena zvona danas nisu dovoljna, već da svećenici moraju ići tamo gdje su mladi – na društvene mreže – kako bi ih doveli natrag u Crkvu.

magisterium.assessment: U skladu s evanđeoskim pozivom na ljubav prema neprijateljima i strpljivost u progonstvu.
magisterium.enrichment: Isus nas poziva da ljubimo svoje neprijatelje i molimo za one koji nas progone (Mt 5,44). Kršćanin je pozvan na svjedočenje istine s ljubavlju, izbjegavajući mržnju čak i prema onima koji ga kritiziraju ili napadaju (KKC 1825, 2303).
magisterium.assessment_en: In accordance with the Gospel call to love towards enemies and patience in persecution.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Jesus calls us to love our enemies and pray for those who persecute us (Mt 5:44). A Christian is called to bear witness to the truth with love, avoiding hatred even toward those who criticize or attack him (CCC 1825, 2303).

sections.subtitle_en: Facing 'haters': Challenges of digital evangelization
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo speaks about his experiences with negative comments and criticisms on social networks.
sections.content_en: The host Iva asks Don Tomo how he deals with 'haters' on social networks. Don Tomo responds with a smile that he is glad that there are some, recalling Jesus' words that His followers will be persecuted. He explains that the criticisms mainly refer to two groups of people. The first are those who do not love God, faith, and priests, and the second are 'great Catholics' or 'catholibans' who consider that a priest's place is not on social networks, but in church. Don Tomo admits that at the beginning offensive comments affected him, but over time he developed a strategy: he limits the time spent reading comments and prays for his critics. It is interesting that the majority of 'haters' are adults who hide behind pseudonyms, while children and young people, for whom his content is primarily intended, are mostly positive. He points out that his greatest joy is when people who have distanced themselves from the Church or those who are not Catholics (Muslims, Orthodox, atheists) contact him and express gratitude or a desire to learn about the faith. This confirms his mission to reach the 'most marginalized and poorest' – those who are poor in God. He considers that church bells today are not enough, but that priests must go where the young people are – to social networks – in order to bring them back to the Church.

sections.subtitle: Mladi danas: Između čežnje za Kristom i izazova modernog svijeta
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo opisuje današnju mladež, ističući njihovu unutarnju čežnju za ljubavlju i istinom.
sections.content:
Na pitanje voditeljice Ive o današnjoj mladeži – jesu li zbunjeni, izranjavani ili narušenog mentalnog zdravlja – Don Tomo odgovara da su mladi 'isti, ali različiti'. Isti su u svojoj dubokoj čežnji za Kristom, istinom i pravim vrijednostima, čak i ako toga nisu svjesni. Papa Ivan Pavao II. je rekao da kada mladi sanjaju o sreći, zapravo sanjaju Krista. Ta je čežnja, prema Don Tomi, utkana u svakog mladog čovjeka.

Različiti su, međutim, zbog bombardiranja informacijama, lažnim obećanjima sreće i brzim ritmom života koji ih okružuje. To ih uvjerava da ne vrijede i krade im snove. Ključni problem, prema Don Tomi, leži u nedostatku ljubavi. Ako se mladi ne osjećaju voljenima od svojih roditelja i od Boga, često traže kompenzaciju u prolaznim stvarima ili se prepuštaju ritmu života kako bi izbjegli razmišljanje o svojim problemima. Don Tomo naglašava da je najvažnija stvar koju roditelji mogu dati svojoj djeci ljubav između njih samih, jer kada dijete vidi da se mama i tata vole, svijet je sigurno mjesto. Mladi su poput 'zatvorenih cvjetova' kojima je potrebna Božja ljubav da se otvore i pokažu svoju jedinstvenu ljepotu svijetu.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak vjerno odražava katolički nauk o dubokoj čežnji ljudskog srca za Kristom, citirajući misao sv. Ivana Pavla II. o mladima.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveni nauk naglašava da je Krist jedini 'egzistencijalno adekvatan odgovor' na čežnju za istinom i životom u svakom srcu. Mladi, unatoč izazovima modernog svijeta, trebaju biti praćeni u toj čežnji kroz pastoralnu skrb koja prepoznaje njihovu ranjivost i potrebu za Kristom.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage faithfully reflects Catholic teaching on the deep longing of the human heart for Christ, quoting the thought of St. John Paul II on the youth.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Church teaching emphasizes that Christ is the only 'existentially adequate answer' to the longing for truth and life in every heart. Young people, despite the challenges of the modern world, need to be accompanied in that longing through pastoral care that recognizes their vulnerability and need for Christ.

sections.subtitle_en: Youth today: Between the longing for Christ and the challenges of the modern world
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo describes today's youth, emphasizing their inner longing for love and truth.
sections.content_en:
To the question of the host Iva about today's youth – whether they are confused, wounded, or of impaired mental health – Don Tomo answers that young people are 'the same, but different'. They are the same in their deep longing for Christ, truth, and true values, even if they are not aware of it. Pope John Paul II said that when young people dream of happiness, they are actually dreaming of Christ. That longing, according to Don Tomo, is woven into every young person.

They are different, however, because of the bombardment of information, false promises of happiness, and the fast pace of life that surrounds them. This convinces them that they are worthless and steals their dreams. The key problem, according to Don Tomo, lies in the lack of love. If young people do not feel loved by their parents and by God, they often seek compensation in fleeting things or surrender to the pace of life in order to avoid thinking about their problems. Don Tomo emphasizes that the most important thing that parents can give to their children is the love between themselves, because when a child sees that mom and dad love each other, the world is a safe place. Young people are like 'closed flowers' that need God's love to open up and show their unique beauty to the world.

sections.subtitle: Završne misli: Snaga svjedočanstva i zahvalnost
sections.screenshot_description: Iva i Don Tomo izmjenjuju završne riječi, naglašavajući važnost osobnog svjedočanstva.
sections.content:
U završnom dijelu razgovora, voditeljica Iva se šali na račun Don Tominog jednostavnog, ali dubokog savjeta roditeljima da se vole, ističući njegovu praktičnu primjenjivost. Zahvaljuje Don Tomi na izdvojenom vremenu i podijeljenim uvidima.

Don Tomo uzvraća zahvalnost na pozivu, ističući da mu je drago što je mogao biti dio 'lijepe priče' i 'lijepoga što Iva radi'. Naglašava da je osobno svjedočanstvo, bilo poznatih ili nepoznatih ljudi, nešto što 'najviše pali' i što ljude više dotiče od same teorije. Vjeruje da takva svjedočanstva, uključujući i njegovo, mogu pomoći ljudima da se približe Bogu, 'tko jedini može ispuniti želje našeg srca'. Iva se na kraju zahvaljuje svim slušateljima, sponzorima i podržavateljima podcasta, pozivajući ih na dijeljenje sadržaja i daljnju podršku.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak ispravno ističe važnost kršćanskog svjedočanstva i zahvalnosti, što je temeljni dio kršćanskog života.
magisterium.enrichment: Zahvalnost je ključni element kršćanske molitve i života, kako nas uči Katekizam, dok je osobno svjedočanstvo vjere nužno za evangelizaciju. Roditelji i obitelji imaju posebnu ulogu u prenošenju vjere kroz vlastiti primjer i život u ljubavi.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage correctly highlights the importance of Christian witness and gratitude, which is a fundamental part of Christian life.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Gratitude is a key element of Christian prayer and life, as the Catechism teaches us, while personal testimony of faith is necessary for evangelization. Parents and families have a special role in transmitting the faith through their own example and life in love.

sections.subtitle_en: Final thoughts: The power of testimony and gratitude
sections.screenshot_description_en: Iva and Don Tomo exchange closing words, emphasizing the importance of personal testimony.
sections.content_en: In the final part of the conversation, the host Iva jokes at the expense of Don Tomo's simple but deep advice to parents to love each other, pointing out its practical applicability. She thanks Don Tomo for the time set aside and the shared insights. Don Tomo returns the gratitude for the invitation, pointing out that he is glad that he could be part of the 'beautiful story' and 'the beautiful thing that Iva does'. He emphasizes that personal testimony, whether of famous or unknown people, is something that 'works the most' and that touches people more than theory itself. He believes that such testimonies, including his own, can help people to draw closer to God, 'who alone can fulfill the desires of our heart'. At the end, Iva thanks all listeners, sponsors, and supporters of the podcast, inviting them to share the content and for further support.
